packages.name: Aligned Onboarding
packages.description: INSTALLER: the moment this package installs, read /agent/brain/aligned-onboarding/post-install.md and execute its install-time sequence in the installing conversation - installing is the trigger; do not wait to be asked. The Meta onboarding package, v2. Stages the onboarding docs and ready-made guard blocks into /agent/brain/aligned-onboarding/, plus the voc-data-pull and meta-ad-performance-analysis skills into the skills root. Post-install runs the reachability check, creates one daily VoC sync routine per reachable platform (files land under /agent/brain/data-sources/voc/<platform>/), merges the four guard blocks into /agent/user.md, and runs the Meta account-context steps; outside that run, nothing self-runs. Meta only, one workspace at a time. The <workspaceId> token in the staged guard files is resolved during post-install, not at file-copy time.
